title.narrative: Expanded Comprehensive Response to HIV/AIDS and Reducing the burden of Tuberculosis in the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste.

description.narrative: Timor-Leste - TB/HIV - Ministry of Health of the Democratic Republic of Timor-Leste - MOH. This program has the following goals: Prevent new infections of HIV, hepatitis B and C, and other STIs. Reduce deaths and improve the health of people living with disease. Eliminate HIV, viral hepatitis and other STIs as major public health threats. To achieve a rapid decline in incidence, mortality and morbidity due to TB while moving on path of ending TB to achieve reduction in the incidence of TB (all forms) by 50% by 2025 and 90% by 2035 (from 2015 baseline figure). The objectives of this program are: Scale up prevention, care and treatment for KPs ensuring an enabling environment and trusted access platform for services. Improve HIV care and treatment services for all PLHIV and ensure that by 2026, 90% of estimated PLHIV are aware of their status; 90% of PLHIV are of ART; and 90% of PLHIV on ART have a suppressed viral load.. Detect at least 95% of estimated TB incident cases by 2026. Improve access to WHO recommeded TB rapid diagnostic tests and ensure that at least 75% of TB cases notified are tested by mWRDs by 2026. Ensure successful treatment for at least 92% of the drug senstive TB patients and 95% of RR/MDR-TB enrolled on treatment by 2026

Percentage of HIV-positive new and relapse TB patients on ART during TB treatment
Percentage of pregnant women living with HIV who received antiretroviral medicine to reduce the risk of vertical transmission of HIV
Percentage of pregnant women who know their HIV status
Percentage of new and relapse TB patients tested using WHO recommended rapid diagnostic tests at the time of diagnosis
Percentage of people newly diagnosed with HIV initiated on ART
Percentage of people on ART among all people living with HIV at the end of the reporting period
Percentage of men who have sex with men reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of transgender people reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of people living with HIV and on ART with viral load test result
Percentage of sex workers that have received an HIV test during the reporting period in KP-specific programs and know their results
Percentage of sex workers reached with HIV prevention programs - defined package of services
Percentage of MSM that have received an HIV test during the reporting period in KP-specific programs and know their results
Number of patients with of all forms of TB notified (i.e., bacteriologically confirmed + clinically diagnosed); *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Number of people in contact with TB patients who began preventive therapy

Treatment success rate- all forms: Percentage of patients with all forms of TB, bacteriologically confirmed plus clinically diagnosed, successfully treated (cured plus treatment completed) among all TB patients notified during a specified period; *includes only those with new and relapse TB
Treatment success rate of RR-TB and/or MDR-TB: Percentage of patients with RR and/or MDR-TB successfully treated
